original: 若かりし頃を思い出すなぁ。

en.text: It reminds me of my youth.
It reminds me of when I was young.

original: 彼の腕のぬくもりを思い出す。

en.text: I remember the warmth of his arms.

original: 言われてみれば、子供の頃、親と一緒にここに来てたの思い出しましたよ。

en.text: Now that you've mentioned it, I remember coming here with my parents when I was a child.

original: 今でも初恋の人を思い出すと、切ないような懐かしいような気分になる。

en.text: Even now, I feel a sense of heartache and longing when I think of my first love.

original: 彼女のエネルギッシュで独裁的な性格を思い出した。

en.text: I recalled her as an energetic, autocratic personality.
